description: Tests the ability of the user to navigate to the documentation page from the footer link and ensures the page loads correctly.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate and click on the 'Documentation' footer link.
Verify that the user is redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
Check if the documentation page loads correctly with all expected elements visible.
expected_results: Documentation page loads successfully with all resources accessible.
edge_cases: Documentation page URL is invalid or unreachable.
Footer link is not visible due to UI rendering issues.
User attempts navigation from an unsupported browser.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the documentation page.
dependencies: Documentation page must be functional and accessible.
Footer links must be properly configured.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the footer link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify proper ARIA roles for the 'Documentation' link.
Ensure readable font size and color contrast on the documentation page.
